description:
Sicily is not polished. Not refined. But that’s its beauty. An island shaped by Greeks, Romans, Arabs, Normans, and Spanish — each leaving their mark, none erasing the other. From the Valley of the Temples in Agrigento to the mosaics of Piazza Armerina. From the Greek Theater of Taormina to the Baroque towns of Noto, Ragusa, and Modica. From Palermo’s layered chaos to the quiet salt pans near Trapani. And always, Mount Etna in the background — reminding us that centuries of human history are just moments in nature’s time.
